Author: Legends of the Game
Name: Time Memoria
Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
Changelog:
Food by role, and where each food is.
Food:
- New /tm food window: the strongest meal you hold for each role and where it is (inventory, saddlebag or a retainer by name), plus the food you ate and the time that remains.
- In the Bonuses tab, put the cursor on a food's name to see each place that holds it, in NQ and HQ.
- The Bonuses tab and /tmmini find saddlebag food immediately after you start the game. The premium saddlebag is included.
Help:
- The game-styled window's Help tab has an Open the issue tracker button. You must have a GitHub account to open an issue.
Exports:
- Your last 5 exports for each character are kept in the exports folder of the configuration folder. Nothing is sent anywhere.
- Fix: the Ledger export no longer counts the Hall of the Novice exercises as duties.
